content: Large Data Path Excluded API Functions In case a signal is contained by ComIPdu with ComIPduLargeData set to true, the call to the following APIs is not supported for that signal: • Com_SendSignal • Com_SendDynSignal • Com_ReceiveSignal • Com_ReceiveDynSignal • Com_ReceiveSignalWithMetaData • Com_ReceiveDynSignalWithMetaData • Com_SendSignalWithMetaData • Com_SendDynSignalWithMetaData
